ns2:course.label: Practical Problems in Atg
ns2:course.description: Course covers the professional standards relating to corporate financial reporting, taxation, auditing and public sector reporting. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated up to 16 hours if topics vary. Credit is not given towards degree requirements. Prerequisite: Concurrent registration in the University's CPA Review course.
